- Initial public release of data-minimizer (v1.1.0).
- Enables one-click masking of phone numbers, emails, ID numbers, and user-specified names from text before sharing with AI.
- Outputs both desensitized text and a desensitization report.
- Supports custom name lists via --names and JSON output with --json.
- Cross-platform support for Windows, macOS, and Linux; no external dependencies.
- No sensitive data stored; only local processing and exit codes for result/error indication.
